decision.explanation: The original sources (D1S1–D1S14) confirm that Pietro de Rosa holds the position of Diocesan Bishop, with multiple references to his role and responsibilities in the Roman Catholic Church. Document D2S1–D2S18 confirms that he has also been appointed as a Member of the Florida House of Representatives, making him the first clergy member to hold such a position. The proposed candidate 'Representative for District 105' (C2) is redundant and less specific than the accepted answer 'Member of the Florida House of Representatives,' which already encompasses the representative role. All accepted answers are directly supported by the provided sources.
